piece_type: DTC online video interview with company executives (Dr. Clare Lee, Rhonda Pacheco) on okcfox.com (Fox25 “Living Oklahoma”, July 11, 2025; “this segment is sponsored by Eli Lilly and Company”)

cases.claim: “look out for FDA-approved safe and authentic medicines if they are already on treatment for obesity and to avoid those unapproved ones. . . .” | “We at Lilly are providing options. One of the options for treatment is Zepbound, which is now available at LillyDirect which is our self-pay pharmacy solution. This provides an option to patients to get access to safe and effective authentic medicine. . . .”
cases.context: Company medical affairs and commercial executives in a TV-station interview segment; Boxed Warning for thyroid C-cell tumors.
cases.rationale: Benefit claims ('safe and effective') with no risk information.
cases.check: Rule: executive/spokesperson media appearances naming the product with benefit or 'safe and effective' language require risk information.

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.claim: [Omission] limitations of use: “ZEPBOUND contains tirzepatide. Coadministration with other tirzepatide containing products or with any glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist is not recommended.”
cases.context: Indication in combination with reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.
cases.check: Rule: indication mentions must include PI limitations of use.

cases.cat: Failure to submit at first use (Form FDA 2253)
cases.claim: [Process] video not submitted under Form FDA 2253 at initial publication
cases.check: Process rule: media appearances by company reps promoting a product need 2253 submission.
